note: Public-facing variant library. The dashboard reads this file. Set 'published': true and fill 'repo' only when a repository is genuinely live — an entry pointing at nothing costs more credibility than a missing row.

variants.name: Research
variants.governs: Research projects — sources, claims, and synthesis
variants.audience: Researchers, analysts, and anyone whose output rests on a chain of sources
variants.detail: Dual mode. The researcher mode governs one person's programme; the supervisor mode governs several people's work against one standard, which is the case no per-repo spec tool addresses.

variants.name: Contractor Handoff
variants.governs: Handing an AI-started build to a human who was not there
variants.audience: Anyone who has started something with an agent and needs a person to finish it
variants.detail: The clearest case for governance that outlives one operator. The contractor reads the anchor instead of being briefed, and the decisions they inherit come with their reasons attached.

variants.name: Short-Form Video Channel
variants.governs: A video channel as a governed production pipeline
variants.audience: Creators running a recurring content operation
variants.detail: A meta-build for channel setup plus a recurring per-video sequence. Evidence for the claim that this works outside software.

variants.name: Courseware
variants.audience: Anyone building teaching material that outlives one draft

variants.name: Atlas
variants.governs: Operator infrastructure — a portfolio catalogue across many repos
variants.audience: Operators running eight or more governed projects
variants.detail: Not a starting point. Useful once you have enough governed projects that finding the right one is itself a problem.

variants.name: Suzerain
variants.governs: Operator infrastructure — cross-repo and lineage governance
variants.audience: Operators whose projects inherit from one another
variants.detail: Not a starting point. Handles the case where one project's decisions must bind its descendants.

variants.name: Capture Plugin
variants.governs: Capturing decision-dense exchanges from any AI chat into a governed repo
variants.audience: Anyone whose decisions currently die in chat history
variants.detail: The wedge. Gated behind the MVP proof gate — it is not started early, on purpose, because starting it early is exactly the failure this project was built to correct.
